description: The pie chart illustrates the time distribution between two components of the Paper Copilot system: "Reduction" and "Efficient deployment." The chart is divided into two slices, with the larger brown slice representing "Reduction," which accounts for 60.9 seconds (69.92% of the total time). The smaller blue slice, labeled "Efficient deployment," represents 26.2 seconds (30.08% of the total time). The percentages are clearly labeled within each slice, and the chart uses distinct colors to differentiate the two categories. The "Reduction" segment is visually larger, reflecting its greater proportion of the total time.
